visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish-brown hair tied back, wearing a green tweed dress, a pearl necklace, and a yellow cardigan over her shoulders, stands against a white wall. She is shouting and gesturing aggressively with her hands, exhibiting extreme anger and frustration. (2) The scene cuts to the same woman dressed in a black and white maid costume, holding a mop handle and looking distressed. A young boy with glasses and a butler-style vest appears in the background, diligently wiping a tall black lamp with a bright green cleaning cloth. (3) The woman in the green dress returns to the frame, still venting. The boy approaches her from the side, holding a smartphone and pointing to the screen with a helpful expression. (4) A close-up shot shows the smartphone screen displaying the 'Tiger Master' (師虎來了) home repair app interface with a map and service icons. (5) The boy briefly appears in a tiger-print jumpsuit, making a roaring pose with his hands like claws. (6) The woman in the green dress now looks calm and happy, speaking directly to the camera. Intercut with this are close-ups of home damage: a ceiling with bubbling, peeling paint from water damage, and cracked exterior wall tiles. (7) Real-world footage shows repairmen in red shirts and white safety helmets working on an exterior wall using a tall ladder. One uses a sealant gun, another paints a white interior ceiling. (8) Detailed digital overlays and screenshots of the app appear, illustrating booking screens, price quotes, and the '3/7 payment' policy text. (9) The woman is now seated on a brown leather sofa, gesturing enthusiastically as she concludes her explanation. The boy appears at the end, massaging her shoulders as they both smile at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female vocals shouting in a mixture of Mandarin and Hokkien, displaying high pitch variability and aggressive intonation. BGM is a bouncy, comedic orchestral track with strings and light percussion. (2) A softer, pleading female voice responds. Sound of a mop handle clicking against a surface is briefly audible. (3) A young boy's voice enters, sounding helpful and calm with moderate pitch. BGM transitions to a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar track with a steady pop beat. (4) A loud, synthesized growl SFX plays as the boy makes a tiger pose. (5) The primary female voice shifts to a professional, articulate narrative tone, explaining app features. Frequent 'ding' and 'whoosh' UI SFXs highlight appearing text overlays. (6) The vocal track remains continuous with minimal pauses as she details the payment plan. BGM maintains a consistent, happy major-mode energy. (7) Final segment features a playful dialogue between the woman and the boy with light-hearted laughter.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Feature Breakdown -> Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Tiger Master' (師虎來了) home repair app. It uses a comedic skit about the frustrations of finding reliable, fairly-priced repairmen to introduce the app as a secure, transparent, and efficient solution for various household maintenance needs.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the app, naming the brand multiple times, and providing a detailed explanation of the payment and warranty policies.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines short-form comedic drama with a structured product pitch, making technical service details like payment plans engaging for a general audience.
